headline: California puts AI auditors under Government Operations Agency registration
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

California puts AI auditors under registration with the Government Operations Agency starting January 1, 2029, and prohibits unregistered persons from conducting covered AI audits. Passed.

11 measures in nine states would have an AI service check the identity or age of the people who use it.

133 measures in 35 jurisdictions name the same fear: Deepfakes.

1,378 measures tracked. 505 carry a control. 174 offices hold one.
